[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Oskar Jyng''' was formerly a design team chief at [[Ubrikkian Transports/Legends|Ubrikkian Transports]] before being recruited to leave his job to work for the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. While with the CSA's [[Research Division]], he developed the [[War wheel]].
